name: rwa-adapter-mcp
description: MCP server for the IndexFlow multi-asset RWAReserveAdapter on Mantle. Exposes read tools (reserve state, pending redemptions, yield landscape, simulate_*) and write tools (allocate_to_rwa, withdraw_from_rwa, harvest_rwa_yield, set_reserve_token, rebalance_reserve) backed by `cast` calls against the vault and adapter. Required by agents/rwa-treasurer.md, meth-carry-manager.md, and rwa-yield-router.md.
